claim.claim-text: 2. The ultrasonic mist inhaler according to claim 1, wherein the capillary element (7) is of a thickness between 0.27mm and 0.32mm and, preferably, has a density between 38 g/m<2> and 48 g/m<2>.
3. The ultrasonic mist inhaler according to claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the capillary element (7) includes at least a portion having a flat shape.

4. The ultrasonic mist inhaler according to the any of the preceding claims, wherein said liquid to be received in the liquid chamber (21) comprises 57-70 % (w/w) vegetable glycerin and 30-43% (w/w) propylene glycol, said propylene glycol including nicotine and flavorings.
